import duckdb
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv("orders_3m.csv")
by_shop = duckdb.sql("SELECT shop_id, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM df GROUP BY shop_id").df()
shares = duckdb.sql("SELECT shop_id, revenue, ROUND(100 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM by_shop ORDER BY pct DESC").df()
print(shares)
expect: Код применяет изученную операцию к данным и сохраняет требуемые переменные; сверяю значения и тип результата.

import duckdb
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv("orders_3m.csv")
quart=duckdb.sql("WITH g AS (SELECT client_id,SUM(amount) AS spent FROM df WHERE client_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_id),q AS (SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY spent DESC,client_id) AS quartile FROM g) SELECT quartile,COUNT(*) AS guests,SUM(spent) AS revenue,ROUND(100*SUM(spent)/SUM(SUM(spent)) OVER (),1) AS pct FROM q GROUP BY quartile ORDER BY quartile").df()
top_pct=quart.loc[quart["quartile"]==1,"pct"].iloc[0]
expect: Код применяет изученную операцию к данным и сохраняет требуемые переменные; сверяю значения и тип результата.

import duckdb
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv("orders_3m.csv",parse_dates=["datetime"])
mom_shop=duckdb.sql("WITH m AS (SELECT shop_id,date_trunc('month',datetime) AS month,SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM df GROUP BY shop_id,month) SELECT shop_id,month,revenue,ROUND(100*(revenue/LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id ORDER BY month)-1),1) AS growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY shop_id,month").df()
falls=mom_shop[mom_shop["growth_pct"]<0]
expect: Код применяет изученную операцию к данным и сохраняет требуемые переменные; сверяю значения и тип результата.

import duckdb
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv("orders_3m.csv",parse_dates=["datetime"])
gaps=duckdb.sql("WITH x AS (SELECT client_id,CAST(datetime AS DATE) AS day,LEAD(CAST(datetime AS DATE)) OVER (PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY datetime,order_id) AS next_day FROM df WHERE client_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT client_id,day,next_day,next_day-day AS days FROM x WHERE next_day IS NOT NULL").df()
avg_gap=round(gaps["days"].mean(),1)
median_gap=gaps["days"].median()

import duckdb
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv("orders_3m.csv",parse_dates=["datetime"])
streaks=duckdb.sql("WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT shop_id,CAST(datetime AS DATE) AS day FROM df),r AS (SELECT *,day-CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id ORDER BY day) AS INTEGER) AS grp FROM d),s AS (SELECT shop_id,MIN(day) AS start,MAX(day) AS finish,COUNT(*) AS days FROM r GROUP BY shop_id,grp) SELECT shop_id,start,finish,days FROM s QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id ORDER BY days DESC,start)=1 ORDER BY shop_id").df()
expect: Код применяет изученную операцию к данным и сохраняет требуемые переменные; сверяю значения и тип результата.
